prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop homepage comp for fcullmann.com, landscape 1440×1000-like viewport
Primary request: Execute the familiar, category-standard personal developer portfolio and online tools homepage at excellent craft quality.
Structure: slim centered top navigation with a small FU wordmark; conventional two-column hero with 'Florian Ullmann', 'Senior Software Engineer', a short direct introduction, primary 'Explore tools' and secondary 'View projects' actions; an abstract neutral code/workspace visual instead of a portrait; below, a clearly titled Featured tools row ordered by popularity; then category browsing and a Latest writing list. English UI labels: 'Home', 'Tools', 'Projects', 'Articles', 'About', 'Featured tools', 'JSON Formatter', 'Base64', 'UUID Generator', 'Latest writing'.
Visual world: polished contemporary SaaS/developer portfolio, white #FFFFFF, deep navy #12213A, clear blue #2563EB, pale neutral #E9EEF5, precise sans-serif typography, generous whitespace, restrained soft neutral panels. Immediate legibility and accessibility.
Constraints: this is intentionally the conventional category option and should echo the supplied structural mockup without copying it; no fake portrait, no fake metrics, no testimonials, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no neon, no browser chrome, no device frame, no watermark, no excessive pill shapes, avoid card-on-card nesting, keep all visible copy coherent. The result must clearly be a usable website screen, not an illustration or poster.
